drift.description: Whether the touched files still match the recorded fingerprints.

backup_dir.description: Relative backup directory, when bytes were preserved.

EventId.description:
History event id (ULID string).

Invariant: lexical order equals creation order inside one store.

SkillName.description:
Lexical skill name: the directory name that holds `SKILL.md`.

Invariant: two deployments with the same `SkillName` are the same skill,
even when their bytes differ. A symlink alias with another name is another
skill.

AgentIdentity.description:
Kebab-case harness identifier, for example `claude-code` or `open-code`.

Invariant: the string is the serde wire name used by the desktop app
today. `open-code` is canonical; `opencode` is only a CLI binary name and
is never stored in an `AgentId`.

RestoreCapability.description: Whether a history event can be restored.

oneOf.description: Already reverted by the named event.
The row's kind is not known to this version of the core.

`pending`, or `failed`/`interrupted` without a `restore_backup`
inverse and a `backup_dir`: the row's inverse never moved what it
describes, or there is no backup for a drift-checked restore to
apply, so applying it would act on live state the row does not own.

status.description: The row's status, so a caller can explain the refusal.

DriftState.description: Whether the files an event touched still hold the bytes it recorded.

oneOf.description:
`list_events` did not compare fingerprints (the row has no inverse,
or the caller did not ask).
Live fingerprints match the recorded post-mutation fingerprints.
At least one path changed since the event; restore needs `force`.
